headline: Vale Shares Drop for Sixth Session to 12-Month Low Amid Mining Sell-Off
summary: Shares of Brazilian mining giant Vale fell 2.1%, marking a sixth consecutive session of declines and touching a one-year low as global mining equities faced broad liquidation.
why: Vale is one of the world's largest iron ore producers. Its stock performance reflects global industrial demand expectations and steel manufacturing activity.

impacts.name: Vale SA
impacts.why: Broad selling in global resource stocks pushed Vale equity down to its lowest level in twelve months.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A global sell-off in commodity producers driven by weakening growth expectations depressed major mining equity prices.
